what: doublegate's API as data — rendered from the code that serves it, checked against it in the code repositories' CI, published here as a snapshot

mcp-tools.json.about: the tool schemas each tier serves over the agent-tool protocol — what tools/list answers — and the instructions paragraph the handshake carries

daemon-rpc.json.about: every verb on the gate's local socket: parameters, role, the proof each needs; a running gate answers the same to dg.describe

note.schema.json.about: JSON Schema of a published note's data — the closed field set a subscriber or a knowledge map may rely on

openapi.json.about: OpenAPI 3.1 for the organization gate's keyed HTTP surface; a running gate serves it at GET /openapi.json to any valid key
